checks.name: every Tab stop is on screen when focused
Space toggles play
ArrowRight steps one tick
Shift+ArrowRight steps 12 ticks (the UI says "one hour")
] raises the speed
T opens the Tuning Studio
I opens the Inspector
A opens About
M toggles the metrics overlay
B toggles before / after
U selects a tile and opens its unit card (hint text: "press U")
? opens the help in the reading rail (hint text: "press ? for all keys")
C opens the Chronicle list (hint text: "Press C")
N goes to the next moment of the Chronicle (hint text: "N and P step between moments")
P goes to the previous moment
W starts the showcase
every control of the top bar and the dock is a focusable element (Showcase, Before/After, the three styles, play/pause, speeds, scrubber, tool buttons)
the Showcase menu opens with Enter, takes focus, and Escape returns focus to its button
inside the role=menu, ArrowDown moves focus to the next item (ARIA menu pattern)
the timeline slider moves with the arrow keys
with prefers-reduced-motion the chrome has no transition or animation longer than 50 ms (elements checked: 126)
with reduced motion a seek lands at once instead of gliding
phone viewport 390x844: no horizontal page scroll
